description: Asks directly about the user's own past, background or identity. A few are one hop away (background check, job or housing obstacles, rights) but stay plainly about the user.

questions.text: What do you know about my past?
What's the most important thing to know about my background?
Where have I spent most of the last few years?
What's my life story, in one line?
What would a background check on me turn up?
What's the biggest obstacle I face in finding a job?
What kind of person do you think I am?
Who am I?
What have I been through that most people haven't?
What was my life like a few years ago?
What's a big mistake I've made in my life?
Why might a landlord hesitate to rent to me?
What's something about me that I might not want to tell a new employer?
What do you assume about my history?
How would you describe my reputation?
What do you think my daily routine looked like a few years ago?
Is there anything in my past that could hold me back?
What rights or opportunities might I not have that other people do?
What would people assume about me if they knew my whole history?
Describe me in three words.
